facts.fact: Cameroon Tribune reports ANTIC, the national ICT agency, has an incident-handling service and co-hosted a national cyberspace security forum in Yaoundé opened 2026-09-29.
facts.system: ANTIC (Agence nationale des technologies de l'information et de la communication)

facts.fact: ANTIC presented a March 2026 ransomware case at a public body, where its team went on site, after which 50% of the body's IT system was down and email was cut for nearly a month.
